specialRules.name: election-timeout-only-from-follower
specialRules.note: ElectionTimeout (no leader contact within the timeout) only starts a new election from Follower; a no-op (reject) from Candidate, Leader, or Shutdown.

specialRules.name: election-won-only-from-candidate
specialRules.note: ElectionWon (quorum of votes granted) only promotes to Leader when currently Candidate; a no-op elsewhere.

specialRules.name: quorum-lost-only-from-leader
specialRules.note: QuorumLost (failed to contact a quorum / stepped down / removed self / lost a verify round) only demotes a Leader to Follower at the same term; a no-op elsewhere.

specialRules.name: newer-term-seen-goes-to-follower
specialRules.note: NewerTermSeen (an RPC or vote/pre-vote response carrying a term greater than the current one) moves ANY role -- Follower, Candidate, or Leader -- to Follower at the new term.

specialRules.name: shutdown-is-terminal-from-any-role
specialRules.note: ShutdownRequested moves any role (including Shutdown itself, as a no-op) to the terminal Shutdown state.
